    The grading of a push-down #

    The total space of a representation of a convex piece of the cover is graded by the degrees of the points (pdGr). The push-down of an indecomposable representation is graded-indecomposable (isGrIndec_pdGr), hence indecomposable when the fundamental group is torsion-free (isIndecMod_pdMod).
